newsitem.title: USA: Quickturn Design stake held by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Quickturn Design stake held by Vinik group.

text.p: A group including Vinik Asset Management LP and former Fidelity Investments fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said Tuesday it holds a 5.9 percent stake in Quickturn Design Systems Inc or 832,000 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake between Nov 12 and Dec 5 at prices ranging from $15.1750 to $17.8125 per share.
The group holds the stake in the Mountain View, Calif company for investment purposes.
